dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: So, Nam, why did you become a teacher?
dialogue.reading: soʊ, ˈnɑːm, ˈwaɪ dɪd juː bɪˈkʌm ə ˈtiːtʃər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Well, let me see. I've always loved languages, you know?
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl, ˈlɛt mi ˈsiː. aɪv ˈɔːlweɪz ˈlʌvd ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒɪz, juː ˈnoʊ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Me too. Is teaching what you expected?
dialogue.reading: miː ˈtuː. ɪz ˈtiːtʃɪŋ ˈwʌt juː ɪkˈspɛktɪd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not exactly. It's… how can I put it? It's harder than I thought, but I love it.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ɪɡˈzæktli. ɪts… ˈhaʊ kən aɪ ˈpʊt ɪt? ɪts ˈhɑːrdər ðən aɪ ˈθɔːt, bʌt aɪ ˈlʌv ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I mean, the kids have so much energy! I'm exhausted every evening.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈmiːn, ðə ˈkɪdz ˈhæv soʊ ˈmʌtʃ ˈɛnərdʒi! aɪm ɪɡˈzɔːstɪd ˈɛvri ˈiːvnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Ha! I can imagine. Do you want to stay at that school for a long time?
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! aɪ kən ɪˈmædʒɪn. duː juː ˈwɑːnt tə ˈsteɪ ət ðæt ˈskuːl fər ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈtaɪm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Well, as I said, I love it. But one day, I'd like to open my own school.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl, æz aɪ ˈsɛd, aɪ ˈlʌv ɪt. bʌt ˈwʌn ˈdeɪ, aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈoʊpən maɪ ˈoʊn ˈskuːl.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Your own school? That's a big dream.
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈoʊn ˈskuːl? ðæts ə ˈbɪɡ ˈdriːm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know. I mean, I don't have the money yet. But, you know, step by step.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. aɪ ˈmiːn, aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈhæv ðə ˈmʌni ˈjɛt. bʌt, juː ˈnoʊ, ˈstɛp baɪ ˈstɛp.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Let me see… A friend of mine runs a language school. Maybe she could give you some advice.
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛt mi ˈsiː… ə ˈfrɛnd əv ˈmaɪn ˈrʌnz ə ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ ˌskuːl. ˈmeɪbi ʃiː kʊd ˈɡɪv juː sʌm ədˈvaɪs.
